title: Concept: Django DisallowedHost page in a response
description: A Django DisallowedHost error page in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The page prints the exact Host header the server rejected and the list of allowed hosts, which tells an attacker which virtual hosts the deployment answers to.
applicability: Django applications with DEBUG on or an over-broad ALLOWED_HOSTS wildcard.
risk: The allowed-host list maps the estate and reveals administrative virtual hosts.
